---- MODULE OpenAddressing ----
EXTENDS OpenAddressingDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS

LOCAL OAProof == INSTANCE TLAPS
LOCAL OASeqFacts == INSTANCE SequenceTheorems

OAEvLabels == {"strIns", "nestedIns", "set", "flush", "rtrn"}
OAStackOK(s) ==
  \/ s = <<>>
  \/ /\ s = <<s[1]>>
     /\ s[1].pc = "endEv"
OAInv ==
  /\ history \subseteq fps
  /\ DOMAIN pc = ProcSet
  /\ DOMAIN fp = ProcSet
  /\ DOMAIN stack = ProcSet
  /\ \A t \in ProcSet:
       /\ fp[t] \in fps \/ pc[t] \in {"pick", "Done"}
       /\ OAStackOK(stack[t])
       /\ IF pc[t] \in OAEvLabels THEN Len(stack[t]) = 1
                                  ELSE stack[t] = <<>>
  /\ CompleteAsSafety

LEMMA OAInitial == Init => OAInv
BY OAProof!SMTT("r30") DEF Init, OAInv, OAStackOK, CompleteAsSafety,
                         ProcSet, OAEvLabels

LEMMA OAStep_strIns ==
  ASSUME OAInv, NEW t \in ProcSet, strIns(t)
  PROVE OAInv'
BY OAProof!SMTT("r30") DEF OAInv, OAStackOK, OAEvLabels,
  CompleteAsSafety, strIns, ProcSet

LEMMA OAStep_nestedIns ==
  ASSUME OAInv, NEW t \in ProcSet, nestedIns(t)
  PROVE OAInv'
BY OAProof!SMTT("r30") DEF OAInv, OAStackOK, OAEvLabels,
  CompleteAsSafety, nestedIns, ProcSet

LEMMA OAStep_set ==
  ASSUME OAInv, NEW t \in ProcSet, set(t)
  PROVE OAInv'
BY OAProof!SMTT("r30") DEF OAInv, OAStackOK, OAEvLabels,
  CompleteAsSafety, set, ProcSet

LEMMA OAStep_flush ==
  ASSUME OAInv, NEW t \in ProcSet, flush(t)
  PROVE OAInv'
BY OAProof!SMTT("r30") DEF OAInv, OAStackOK, OAEvLabels,
  CompleteAsSafety, flush, ProcSet

LEMMA OASingletonTail ==
  ASSUME NEW x
  PROVE Tail(<<x>>) = <<>> /\ Head(<<x>>) = x
<1>1. <<>> \in Seq({x}) /\ Append(<<>>, x) = <<x>>
  BY OAProof!SMTT("r10")
<1> QED BY <1>1, OASeqFacts!HeadTailAppend,
           OAProof!SMTT("r10")

LEMMA OAStep_rtrn ==
  ASSUME OAInv, NEW t \in ProcSet, rtrn(t)
  PROVE OAInv'
<1>1. history' \subseteq fps
  BY OAProof!SMTT("r10") DEF OAInv, rtrn
<1>2. CompleteAsSafety'
  BY OAProof!SMTT("r10") DEF OAInv, CompleteAsSafety, rtrn,
    OAStackOK, OAEvLabels, ProcSet
<1>3. DOMAIN pc' = ProcSet /\ DOMAIN fp' = ProcSet
       /\ DOMAIN stack' = ProcSet
  BY OAProof!SMTT("r10") DEF OAInv, rtrn, ProcSet
<1>0. stack[t] = <<stack[t][1]>> /\
       Head(stack[t]).pc = "endEv" /\ Tail(stack[t]) = <<>>
  BY OASingletonTail, OAProof!SMTT("r30") DEF OAInv, OAStackOK, OAEvLabels, rtrn
<1>4. \A u \in ProcSet:
       /\ fp'[u] \in fps \/ pc'[u] \in {"pick", "Done"}
       /\ OAStackOK(stack'[u])
       /\ IF pc'[u] \in OAEvLabels THEN Len(stack'[u]) = 1
                                   ELSE stack'[u] = <<>>
  BY <1>0, OAProof!SMTT("r30") DEF OAInv, OAStackOK, OAEvLabels, rtrn,
     ProcSet
<1> QED BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, <1>4, OAProof!SMTT("r10") DEF OAInv

LEMMA OAStep_pick ==
  ASSUME OAInv, NEW t \in ProcSet, pick(t)
  PROVE OAInv'
<1>1. history' \subseteq fps
  BY OAProof!SMTT("r10") DEF OAInv, pick
<1>2. CompleteAsSafety'
  <2>1. history \subseteq fps /\ DOMAIN pc = ProcSet
        /\ CompleteAsSafety
    BY OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF OAInv
  <2>2. ASSUME NEW u \in ProcSet, pc'[u] = "Done"
        PROVE history' = fps
    BY <2>2, <2>1, OAProof!SMTT("r30") DEF pick, CompleteAsSafety
  <2> QED BY <2>2, OAProof!SMTT("r10") DEF CompleteAsSafety
<1>3. DOMAIN pc' = ProcSet /\ DOMAIN fp' = ProcSet
       /\ DOMAIN stack' = ProcSet
  BY OAProof!SMTT("r10") DEF OAInv, pick, ProcSet
<1>4. \A u \in ProcSet:
       /\ fp'[u] \in fps \/ pc'[u] \in {"pick", "Done"}
       /\ OAStackOK(stack'[u])
       /\ IF pc'[u] \in OAEvLabels THEN Len(stack'[u]) = 1
                                   ELSE stack'[u] = <<>>
  BY OAProof!SMTT("r30") DEF OAInv, OAStackOK, OAEvLabels, pick,
     ProcSet
<1> QED BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, <1>4, OAProof!SMTT("r10") DEF OAInv

LEMMA OAStep_put ==
  ASSUME OAInv, NEW t \in ProcSet, put(t)
  PROVE OAInv'
BY OAProof!SMTT("r30") DEF OAInv, OAStackOK, OAEvLabels,
  CompleteAsSafety, put, ProcSet

LEMMA OAStep_waitEv ==
  ASSUME OAInv, NEW t \in ProcSet, waitEv(t)
  PROVE OAInv'
BY OAProof!SMTT("r30") DEF OAInv, OAStackOK, OAEvLabels,
  CompleteAsSafety, waitEv, ProcSet

LEMMA OAStep_endWEv ==
  ASSUME OAInv, NEW t \in ProcSet, endWEv(t)
  PROVE OAInv'
BY OAProof!SMTT("r30") DEF OAInv, OAStackOK, OAEvLabels,
  CompleteAsSafety, endWEv, ProcSet

LEMMA OAStep_chkSnc ==
  ASSUME OAInv, NEW t \in ProcSet, chkSnc(t)
  PROVE OAInv'
BY OAProof!SMTT("r30") DEF OAInv, OAStackOK, OAEvLabels,
  CompleteAsSafety, chkSnc, ProcSet

LEMMA OAStep_cntns ==
  ASSUME OAInv, NEW t \in ProcSet, cntns(t)
  PROVE OAInv'
BY OAProof!SMTT("r30") DEF OAInv, OAStackOK, OAEvLabels,
  CompleteAsSafety, cntns, ProcSet

LEMMA OAStep_onSnc ==
  ASSUME OAInv, NEW t \in ProcSet, onSnc(t)
  PROVE OAInv'
BY OAProof!SMTT("r30") DEF OAInv, OAStackOK, OAEvLabels,
  CompleteAsSafety, onSnc, ProcSet

LEMMA OAStep_insrt ==
  ASSUME OAInv, NEW t \in ProcSet, insrt(t)
  PROVE OAInv'
BY OAProof!SMTT("r30") DEF OAInv, OAStackOK, OAEvLabels,
  CompleteAsSafety, insrt, ProcSet

LEMMA OAStep_isMth ==
  ASSUME OAInv, NEW t \in ProcSet, isMth(t)
  PROVE OAInv'
BY OAProof!SMTT("r30") DEF OAInv, OAStackOK, OAEvLabels,
  CompleteAsSafety, isMth, ProcSet

LEMMA OAStep_cas ==
  ASSUME OAInv, NEW t \in ProcSet, cas(t)
  PROVE OAInv'
<1>1. history' \subseteq fps
  BY OAProof!SMTT("r10") DEF OAInv, cas
<1>2. CompleteAsSafety'
  <2>1. history \subseteq fps /\ DOMAIN pc = ProcSet
        /\ CompleteAsSafety
    BY OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF OAInv
  <2>2. ASSUME NEW u \in ProcSet, pc'[u] = "Done"
        PROVE history' = fps
    <3>1. history \subseteq history'
      BY OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF cas
    <3>2. pc[u] = "Done"
      BY <2>2, <2>1, OAProof!SMTT("r10") DEF cas
    <3>3. history = fps
      BY <3>2, <2>2, <2>1, OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF CompleteAsSafety
    <3> QED BY <1>1, <3>1, <3>3, OAProof!SMTT("r5")
  <2> QED BY <2>2, OAProof!SMTT("r10") DEF CompleteAsSafety
<1>3. DOMAIN pc' = ProcSet /\ DOMAIN fp' = ProcSet
       /\ DOMAIN stack' = ProcSet
  BY OAProof!SMTT("r10") DEF OAInv, cas, ProcSet
<1>4. \A u \in ProcSet:
       /\ fp'[u] \in fps \/ pc'[u] \in {"pick", "Done"}
       /\ OAStackOK(stack'[u])
       /\ IF pc'[u] \in OAEvLabels THEN Len(stack'[u]) = 1
                                   ELSE stack'[u] = <<>>
  BY OAProof!SMTT("r30") DEF OAInv, OAStackOK, OAEvLabels, cas,
     ProcSet
<1> QED BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, <1>4, OAProof!SMTT("r10") DEF OAInv

LEMMA OAStep_tryEv ==
  ASSUME OAInv, NEW t \in ProcSet, tryEv(t)
  PROVE OAInv'
BY OAProof!SMTT("r30") DEF OAInv, OAStackOK, OAEvLabels,
  CompleteAsSafety, tryEv, ProcSet

LEMMA OAConcatSingleton ==
  ASSUME NEW x
  PROVE <<x>> \o <<>> = <<x>>
<1>1. <<x>> \in Seq({x})
  BY OAProof!SMTT("r10")
<1> QED BY <1>1, OASeqFacts!ConcatEmptySeq, OAProof!SMTT("r10")

LEMMA OAStep_waitIns ==
  ASSUME OAInv, NEW t \in ProcSet, waitIns(t)
  PROVE OAInv'
<1>1. history' \subseteq fps
  BY OAProof!SMTT("r10") DEF OAInv, waitIns
<1>2. CompleteAsSafety'
  BY OAProof!SMTT("r10") DEF OAInv, CompleteAsSafety, waitIns,
    OAStackOK, OAEvLabels, ProcSet
<1>3. DOMAIN pc' = ProcSet /\ DOMAIN fp' = ProcSet
       /\ DOMAIN stack' = ProcSet
  BY OAProof!SMTT("r10") DEF OAInv, waitIns, ProcSet
<1>0. stack[t] = <<>>
  BY OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF OAInv, OAEvLabels, waitIns
<1>5. stack'[t] =
       <<[procedure |-> "Evict", pc |-> "endEv",
          ei |-> ei[t], ej |-> ej[t], lo |-> lo[t]]>>
  BY <1>0, OAConcatSingleton, OAProof!SMTT("r10") DEF OAInv, waitIns
<1>4. \A u \in ProcSet:
       /\ fp'[u] \in fps \/ pc'[u] \in {"pick", "Done"}
       /\ OAStackOK(stack'[u])
       /\ IF pc'[u] \in OAEvLabels THEN Len(stack'[u]) = 1
                                   ELSE stack'[u] = <<>>
  BY <1>0, <1>5, OAProof!SMTT("r30") DEF OAInv, OAStackOK, OAEvLabels, waitIns,
     ProcSet
<1> QED BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, <1>4, OAProof!SMTT("r10") DEF OAInv

LEMMA OAStep_endEv ==
  ASSUME OAInv, NEW t \in ProcSet, endEv(t)
  PROVE OAInv'
BY OAProof!SMTT("r30") DEF OAInv, OAStackOK, OAEvLabels,
  CompleteAsSafety, endEv, ProcSet


LEMMA OAPreserve == OAInv /\ [Next]_vars => OAInv'
<1>0. OAInv /\ Terminating => OAInv'
  BY OAProof!SMTT("r10") DEF Terminating, vars, OAInv, CompleteAsSafety
<1>1. ASSUME OAInv, Next PROVE OAInv'
  BY <1>1, <1>0, OAStep_strIns, OAStep_nestedIns, OAStep_set, OAStep_flush,
     OAStep_rtrn, OAStep_pick, OAStep_put, OAStep_waitEv,
     OAStep_endWEv, OAStep_chkSnc, OAStep_cntns, OAStep_onSnc,
     OAStep_insrt, OAStep_isMth, OAStep_cas, OAStep_tryEv,
     OAStep_waitIns, OAStep_endEv, OAProof!SMTT("r30")
  DEF Next, Evict, p, ProcSet
<1>2. OAInv /\ UNCHANGED vars => OAInv'
  BY OAProof!SMTT("r30") DEF OAInv, CompleteAsSafety, vars
<1> QED BY <1>1, <1>2, OAProof!SMTT("r30")

LEMMA OAAlways == Spec => []OAInv
<1>1. Init => OAInv BY OAInitial
<1>2. OAInv /\ [Next]_vars => OAInv' BY OAPreserve
<1> QED BY <1>1, <1>2, OAProof!PTL DEF Spec
\* END AGENT HELPERS

THEOREM Spec => []CompleteAsSafety
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF OpenAddressing/OpenAddressing_CompleteAsSafety.tla
BY OAAlways, OAProof!PTL DEF OAInv
\* END AGENT PROOF OpenAddressing/OpenAddressing_CompleteAsSafety.tla

THEOREM Spec => []Consistent
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF OpenAddressing/OpenAddressing_Consistent.tla
BY OAProof!SMTT("r1") DEF Spec
\* END AGENT PROOF OpenAddressing/OpenAddressing_Consistent.tla

THEOREM Spec => []Contains
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF OpenAddressing/OpenAddressing_Contains.tla
BY OAProof!SMTT("r1") DEF Spec
\* END AGENT PROOF OpenAddressing/OpenAddressing_Contains.tla

THEOREM Spec => []Duplicates
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF OpenAddressing/OpenAddressing_Duplicates.tla
BY OAProof!SMTT("r1") DEF Spec
\* END AGENT PROOF OpenAddressing/OpenAddressing_Duplicates.tla

THEOREM Spec => []Sorted
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF OpenAddressing/OpenAddressing_Sorted.tla
BY OAProof!SMTT("r1") DEF Spec
\* END AGENT PROOF OpenAddressing/OpenAddressing_Sorted.tla
====
